categories.main_business_segments: Cabio Biotech primarily operates in three main business segments: human nutrition, animal nutrition, and beauty & personal care. The human nutrition segment focuses on producing key nutritional ingredients such as ARA, DHA, SA, and HMOs for infant formula and health foods. The animal nutrition segment develops lipid nutrition solutions for pets and livestock, including functional pet foods and feed additives. The beauty & personal care segment leverages synthetic biology and omics technologies to develop functional cosmetic ingredients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes synthetic biology as its foundational technology, employing microbial fermentation and cell factory methods to produce bio-based nutritional chemicals. Key technologies include plasma mutagenesis for strain selection, precise fermentation control, high-efficiency separation and purification, microencapsulation, and advanced bioinformatics platforms integrating AI and multi-omics. The company has developed intelligent automated R&D platforms and scalable industrial fermentation processes, enabling high-throughput strain screening and product optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cabio serves major infant formula manufacturers, health food companies, pet food brands, and cosmetic ingredient clients. Its key customers include multinational corporations like Nestlé, Danone, Cargill, and leading domestic dairy companies such as Feihe, Yili, Junlebao, and Mengniu. The products are widely used in infant formula, dietary supplements, pet nutrition, and functional cosmetics, targeting markets in China and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Wuhan, Heilongjiang, and other locations. Its products are sold in over 30 countries and regions including China, Europe, North America, Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, and South Korea. The company is actively expanding its international market presence, especially in Europe and the Asia-Pacific region.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cabio operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of bio-based nutritional ingredients through microbial fermentation. It supplies these ingredients to downstream customers such as infant formula manufacturers, pet food producers, and cosmetic companies. The company also engages in product formulation support and supply chain services for its clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing synthetic biology and integrating AI and multi-omics technologies to accelerate innovation and industrialization of new bioactive molecules. Key R&D directions include expanding the HMOs product line, optimizing lipid nutrition solutions for animals, and developing functional cosmetic ingredients. It emphasizes intelligent automation in R&D, strain genome engineering, fermentation process optimization, and expanding applications across nutrition, animal health, and personal care sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Cabio generates revenue primarily through the sale of bio-based nutritional ingredients and related products to B2B customers. Sales are conducted via direct sales domestically and a combination of direct and distributor sales internationally. The company also earns income from licensing patents and providing technical services to clients. Revenue streams include product sales of ARA, DHA, SA, HMOs, and other specialty ingredients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cabio is a leading domestic player and one of the global major suppliers in the ARA and DHA microbial fermentation market, breaking foreign technology monopolies. It competes with international chemical and biotechnology giants such as BASF, DSM, and DuPont in the bio-based nutritional ingredient sector. The company holds a strong market position in China and is expanding its footprint internationally, leveraging its advanced synthetic biology platform and strategic partnerships with global nutrition companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Cabio achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 555.6 million, representing a 25.19% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 124.2 million, up 35.94%. The company’s R&D investment accounted for 8.62% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. It has steadily grown its asset base and equity, with total assets reaching RMB 1.69 billion and net assets of RMB 1.56 billion by year-end 2024. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues to expand production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cabio emphasizes its unique value proposition based on advanced synthetic biology technology enabling sustainable, high-quality bio-manufacturing of nutritional ingredients. Its products offer high purity, traceability, and environmental benefits compared to traditional sources. The company differentiates through proprietary strain development, intelligent fermentation control, and integrated multi-omics research supporting product efficacy and new application development. Its strong quality management systems and international certifications further enhance customer trust and market competitiveness.
